nom: Peter Thomas Roth 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or dehydrated under-eye skin report the patches visibly plump and hydrate the area, with one calling it the first product to show a difference on her dehydrated skin and deep crow's feet.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with ulcerative colitis flags the carrageenan content as an irritant she tries to avoid despite finding the product effective, and another with a reaction from another cream found the patches calming rather than irritating.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to late 50s report temporary softening of fine lines, crow's feet and smile lines, with effects described as lasting only hours and requiring repeated use rather than permanent change.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers citing fine lines, crow's feet or smile lines report visible temporary softening or plumping after one to few uses; one notes crow's feet fully gone after an overnight use, another that results last only a few hours.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report a cooling, hydrated, plumped feel and softer under-eye skin after use; a larger group of critical reviewers instead report the patches themselves arriving completely dry with little or no serum.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the patches burned her skin leaving red, puffy, sagging marks under both eyes; others describe a calming, soothing effect on irritated or reactive under-eye skin.

aspects.libelle: Patches sliding or slipping out of place

extraits.texte: I didn't want to like these and am not sure I'll repurchase, TBH. The main problem I have with all PTR eye gels is that they contain Carrageenan. I have Ulcertative Colitis, and my doctor has told me to avoid all products with carrageenan, as it is a known irritant to the colon. I know that carrageenan is a large molecule that sits on the skin, doesn't get into the blood stream, and therefore is "safer" to use topically. However, I just always try to avoid carrageenan in skincare. Yes, I should have read the label more carefully before splurging on this product, and that is my fault. However, this product is highly effective at giving you a better looking under eye area. It does reduce any puffiness, any discoloration and temporarily plumps the under eye area. You can also use them for smile lines around the mouth. However, I haven't tried that yet. I'd probably buy any of PTR's eye gels...if he just removed the carrageenan. Love you PTR! Please remove the carrageenan.

I bought this after doing a lot of research on possible products to help with under eye skin. I used them as directed twice and was left with red, puffy, sagging burn marks under both eyes! So disappointed ☹️

extraits.titre: Wish I would have found these sooner!
extraits.texte: I have tried a LOT of different under eye patches for my dehydrated skin and deep crows feet . These are the first ones that I actually saw a visible difference after 1 or 2 uses. I use them almost ever night with amazzzzzzing results.

extraits.titre: My skin at 42 has never been better
extraits.texte: Ok so I just bought this based on fabulous reviews and past wonderful experiences using PTR products and I assure you I'm not disappointed! After one use I'm a secured frequent buyer. The cooling, calming effect is wonderful. I don't particularly enjoy wearing the patches but I'll do it for these results. I have a pesky smile line at top of my cheek right under my eye that has been getting more pronounced as of late and after removing the patch it had completely disappeared!!!! Sold!! It's pricey and sux gettin hooked to expensive but too late hehe.

I've had mild crow's feet for a few years. I used these patches once overnight and my crows feet are competely gone. On top of that my bottom eyelid twitches a few times a day and after using these it relaxed my eye muscles and the twitching as completely stopped.

extraits.titre: Purchased  to reduce swelling  from reaction
extraits.texte: One of the sales associates offered me a set of these to calm my eyes down from a reaction from another cream and my goodness it was so soothing. I purchased some shared with my mom and I find myself putting them on morning and night. They are so soothing and pampering. I wish I would have known about these previously . They are so worth the price. I will agree with another reviewer there should be more product liquid or serum but it's absolutely wonderful. They do come in numerous categories. Cucumber, hydraulic and one or two others but this one is my favorite. I have tried the other's. This one is supreme.....❤
These eye patches are dry. No serum! I thought it was a fluke and was silly enough to buy them again and the same thing, dry. Don't waste your money.
